scope: Matrix-wide Previous/Next Column and Previous/Next top-level Column Group, plus the existing Stop All, are exposed as icon actions and real Trigger Parameters.

navigation.columns: Enabled Columns in document order, including Columns inside nested Groups
navigation.groups: First enabled descendant Column of the adjacent top-level Group, skipping empty or disabled Groups
navigation.anchor: Matrix-wide requested Column, with first or last eligible target when stopped

software.scope: Configured transition and inherited Cell output, group traversal, real Parameter pulses, stop and no history, all script and transport callers, and generated TypeScript parity

bundledApp.scope: Top-left layout and icon accessibility, exact Parameter identities on WebSocket, click and keyboard navigation across nested Groups, Stop, 30 history-safe stop cycles, project reload and existing scoped controls
bundledApp.build: Isolated bundled UI build with pinned FFmpeg DLLs on PATH and Tauri resource copying disabled for this build
